channel.title: Navan Badminton Club
channel.description: Welcome to Navan Badminton Club located at Claremont Stadium in Navan, Co. Meath, Ireland. Club nights every Monday and Wednesday during the season which runs from September to April. Club caters for Adults and Juveniles of all standards from beginner to advanced.

item.title: Club Night
item.description: Join us tonight from 9pm to 11pm as Claremont Stadium turns into a jungle for a fun badminton night with matches and open courts.
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Skip the Politics, Join the Fun!
item.description: Enjoy thrilling tennis matches at Claremont Stadium tonight. Forget the election drama and join us for exciting court action!
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: 🏸🎃 Badminton Halloween Night at Claremont Stadium
item.description: Join us for a spooky badminton night at Claremont Stadium with courts available for members and beginners. Happy Halloween!
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: 🎃 Badminton Night at Claremont Stadium
item.description: Join us at Claremont Stadium for exciting badminton matches from 8:30pm to 11pm. Costumes optional!
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Badminton Night Alert!
